summary: Frontend-only verification of red+gold theme rollout and side-lamp removal on the wedding invitation site. All specified acceptance criteria pass: alternating maroon/cream section pattern is correct, side lamps are fully removed at both desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844), no horizontal overflow, no console errors, and venue QR + directions link render properly.

issues: Hero section renders as a very short maroon band (~140px tall) at the top of the page after the envelope auto-opens; the large 'Rishabh & Ritul' script text that appears on-screen actually belongs to the Invitation section (cream). The hero itself does contain the maroon gradient + gold mandala rings + petals as required, but visually it does not fill the viewport as a hero usually would. Worth confirming with main agent whether this is intentional after removing the side lamps / envelope open transition, or if hero min-height should be restored to 100vh.

venue-section.card: cream, readable, QR + GET DIRECTIONS visible & clickable

action_items: OPTIONAL: Verify whether the hero section is meant to fill the viewport (min-height: 100vh). Currently after auto-open (#open) it renders as a short ~140px maroon strip on 1440x900 desktop.
critical_code_review_comments: Theme switching via a single utility class (.theme-red) on section root is clean and DRY — good approach.
All interactive elements (open-invitation-button, countdown-*, venue-directions-link, sections) expose data-testid — testability is solid.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Site is a Next.js production build served through the preview URL. Use ?/#open to auto-trigger envelope open (open-invitation-button will not be present in the DOM after auto-open). Section order: Hero, Invitation, Countdown, Family, Venue, Footer. Theme pattern: sections 1/3/5 + footer maroon (rgb(90,37,48)→rgb(67,26,34) gradient); sections 2/4 cream. Side-lamps component was deleted; verified 0 matches for .side-lamps/.lamp-medallion.
